run_compute_scaling_factors: run compute_scaling_factors to fit ScaleFactor modules in a FairChem model using training batches
run_fit_cli: run the scaling fit CLI module with --checkpoint and config args to compute scaling factors
refactor_train_batch: refactor _train_batch to customize the forward pass and loss computation for scaling factor fitting
review_prefilled_input: review _prefilled_input helper that uses readline to prefill user input prompts with default values
summarize_compute_scaling_factors: summarize compute_scaling_factors which discovers, sorts by execution order, and fits all ScaleFactor modules in a model
